shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing an armchair near the bookcase end. A woman in an orange shirt sits on the doorway-side sofa seat and recounts the wonderful evening at the social ball. A man in a white shirt sits on the bookcase-side sofa seat, and a woman in a blue shirt sits on the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt describes each dance partner in detail, and the man in a white shirt questions why every dance must be cataloged.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt details the subsequent dances from the evening.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the coffee-table side, centered on the person at the doorway-side sofa seat.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt asks to finish the recap, and the woman in an orange shirt summarizes the successful outcome of the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the coffee table.
